text:
Jordan: kicking off SEA3 bootcamp validation — short rundown of tests we need to pass before handoff. I’ll post checks and quick commands.
Priya: thanks — I can take networking + BGP/route checks.
Alex: I’ll own GPU driver, NVLink and CUDA sanity. Maria: I’ll run the smoke workload and latency checks, and validate autoscaler.
Jordan: top-level acceptance criteria: node readiness 100%, <2% pod restarts in 30m, p95 infer latency <120ms for short prompts, model canary success rate >99%, no packet drops on main fabric for 1h.
Priya: networking checklist: verify VPC routes, ensure two BGP peers established, confirm node MTU 9000, and check flaps. run: ```bash
# from control-plane
ip route show table all | grep sea3
bgpctl show neighbors
```
Priya: found one BGP neighbor in Active state earlier, but it came back. keep an eye.
SRE Bot: deploy/sea3-networking: BGP session to IX-SEA established at 15:02 UTC :white_check_mark:
Alex: infra node health: driver versions should be 535.x, kernel 6.2+, nvidia-smi shows no ECC errors. run: ```bash
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep sea3
ssh node-12 sudo nvidia-smi -q | grep -E "Driver Version|Ecc Errors"
```
Alex: saw one node with driver 532 -> queued reimage. ETA 12m.
Maria: smoke workload (local generator) started against canary model (gpt-small-phi). sending 500 short prompts @10rps.
Maria: initial results: 95% success, p95=110ms, but ~8 errors during blob read from NFS on pods on node-12.
Priya: NFS mount issue likely tied to node-12 I/O path while reimage was happening. re-run after node healthy.
Jordan: checklist item: KV/prefix cache warm-up — we should hit high hit-rate before full traffic. Maria, can you run warmup script?
Maria: running warmup: ```bash
./warmup-prefixes.sh --model gpt-small-phi --iters 20000
```
Maria: warmup hit-rate climbed to 82% in 15m. target >85% for steady-state savings.
Alex: MIG partitions validated on all Ampere nodes, no mismatched configs. NVLink tests show expected bandwidth. :thumbsup:
Priya: network flakiness note: one TOR switch had BFD sessions flapping ~30s; ops-ticket #SEA3-548 opened with provider. provider responded, monitoring.
Jordan: SLO gate: latency and error budget. If errors >1% in 60m we fail and rollback to previous capacity profile. Maria, set alert for 5-min spikes.
Maria: alert created in console: sea3-canary-latency (p95>150ms) and sea3-canary-errors (>1% 5m).
Alex: cost sanity: current GPU packing yields estimated $0.45/seq-token at 8k context for this canary. that's higher than target $0.30. we need to dial batching and quantization suggestions from Optimize.
Jordan: Record of manual overrides: disabled autoscaler burst for initial ramp to control placement. Note in handoff.
Priya: final pre-handoff checks: public egress route tested, NAT gateway throughput 3Gbps confirmed, certs valid for control-plane endpoints.
SRE Bot: healthcheck/sea3: all kube-system pods Running (48/48), control-plane metrics ok, ci-tests passed.
Jordan: blockers: node-12 reimage in progress (driver bump), provider monitoring for TOR flaps. nothing else blocking readiness review.
Alex: reimage finished, driver 535.7 installed, validated.
Maria: re-ran smoke: 500 prompts, 99.4% success, p95=108ms, no NFS errors. KV warmup 88%.
Priya: BGP stable >20m, no further flaps observed.
Jordan: ok — handoff plan: 1) post runbook note in #eng-infra with checklist and artifacts, 2) schedule 30m readiness review with Platform PO, 3) handoff to oncall. Who’s oncall?
Maria: @Alex you’re oncall for this window?
Alex: I can take oncall for the next 2h then handoff to Priya.
Jordan: sign-off criteria met. tagging participants for formal sign-off: Jordan: :white_check_mark:, Priya: :white_check_mark:, Alex: :white_check_mark:, Maria: :white_check_mark:.
Jordan: copying acceptance artifacts: logs + perf graphs uploaded to runbook bucket s3://redwood-runbooks/sea3/validation/1945678901/
Priya: opened handoff ticket SEA3-HANDOFF-1945678901 and assigned to Platform.
SRE Bot: ticket/SEA3-HANDOFF-1945678901 created by Priya at 15:28 UTC
Alex: leaving a note — cost-optimization followup: schedule with Optimize team next week to tune batching profiles and quant quantization rollouts.
Jordan: thanks all. closing thread — please escalate if any regressions in the next 1h. :rocket:
